errors.text_span: 图(1) 显示了中国城镇人口结构的总体分布基于不同书面来源
errors.evidence: The figure shows '各语体中变量词的词频及分布' (word frequency and distribution of variable words across genres), not '中国城镇人口结构' (urban population structure in China).
The figure shows four categories ('新闻', '学术', '网络小说', '微博'), not seven.
The highest bar corresponds to '新闻' (news), not '出生' (birth). No such category exists in the figure.

errors.evidence: The y-axis represents absolute word frequency, not percentage.

The description does not mention the actual purpose of the figure: word frequency and distribution of variable words across genres.
The description omits the y-axis label (word frequency), range (0 to 7000), and units (absolute word frequency).
The description does not mention the x-axis categories ('新闻', '学术', '网络小说', '微博').
The description fails to mention the segmented bar structure, legend, or color coding for variable word categories.
The description does not mention the absence of visual emphasis (e.g., shadows or bolding).
The description does not mention the natural ordering of categories.
